snippet.title: Bear Defence Situation // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778320/Bear_Defence_Situation/

A hybrid card game and tower defence where the hands you play become the towers you build. Defeat the enemies approaching the bear's den and find modifiers that support the elements of your defensive strategy.

Developed by 
earend aka @earend
